(5) “General election” means the election held in even-numbered years on the Tuesday after the first Monday in November to
elect United States senators, representatives in congress, presidential electors, state senators, representatives to the assembly,
district attorneys, state officers other than the state superintendent and judicial officers, and county officers other than supervisors and county executives.
(12s) “Partisan primary” means the primary held the 2nd
Tuesday in August to nominate candidates to be voted for at the
general election.
